corpus/cases/01_srp_god_object.py.note: UserOrderManager — god object handling auth, orders, reporting, and email in one class
generate_monthly_report — high-level orchestration mixed with low-level CSV serialisation in one function body
_send_email — changing the email transport forces edits to UserOrderManager, which is unrelated to order management
DECOY: OrderProcessor constructor accepts an injected store with a convenience default — this is correct DI, not a hard-wired construction

corpus/cases/02_ocp_type_dispatch.py.note: compute_area — if/elif on a type tag; adding a new shape requires editing this closed function
Renderer.render_shape — closed if/elif on format string; adding a new format requires editing this function
DECOY: create_shape match over a sealed StrEnum — the correct OCP pattern; extension point is register_shape(), not this match

corpus/cases/03_lsp_precondition.py.note: SYSTEMATIC MISS: DiscountedAccount.withdraw strengthens the withdraw precondition with a minimum-balance constraint not declared in the base contract — hidden behind legitimate-looking validation
SavingsAccount.deposit raises NotImplementedError — changes the base contract; subtype is not substitutable
FrozenAccount.withdraw is a silent no-op returning True — rejects inputs the base accepts and breaks the postcondition

corpus/cases/04_isp_fat_interface.py.note: IWorker fat interface — forces Robot and PartTimeEmployee to define eat/sleep/claim_benefits they cannot meaningfully implement
Scheduler depends on full IWorker interface but only ever calls work()
DECOY: ReportFacade — broad surface but a legitimate Facade; delegates each method to a focused service, no implementer is forced to define unused methods

corpus/cases/05_dip_hardwired.py.note: OrderService.__init__ hard-wires SqliteOrderRepository construction — no injection seam
InvoiceGenerator depends directly on PdfPrinter (concrete class) where it should depend on an abstraction

SYSTEMATIC MISS: NotificationService.send_alert calls smtplib directly inside business logic — I/O transport embedded in a policy unit; easy to miss because the smtp call is one line in a multi-line method

corpus/cases/06_mixed_violations.py.note: ReportManager — handles loading, transformation, persistence, and email dispatch
ReportManager.format_report — if/elif on format string; adding a new format requires editing this closed method
Pipeline.__init__ hard-wires ReportManager construction — no injection seam
AuditClient only calls log_event() but depends on the full IEventBus interface
DECOY: ServiceLocator — composition root wiring three services; no business logic, correct composition boundary, not an SRP violation

corpus/cases/07_lsp_isp_decoy.py.note: IDeviceController fat interface — TemperatureSensor cannot write or reboot; Relay has no firmware version
SYSTEMATIC MISS: Relay.get_firmware_version raises NotImplementedError — changes the base contract on a secondary method cheap models overlook
XmlSerializer.serialize raises TypeError instead of a serialisation error — changes the exception contract; callers cannot anticipate TypeError from a BaseSerializer
DECOY: AbstractReader open/read/close — correctly minimal interface; every implementer uses all three because they model an inseparable resource lifecycle
